content.text: Get mesmerised with this 8 Days Meghalaya Holiday Tour and Explore the cultural and ecological monuments of Jaintia Hills while taking in the renowned sights of Sohra. In Mawphlang's Sacred Grove, walk under the shade of an old canopy, feel the breeze on the edge of the massive Laitlum canyon, and wonder at the rock formations and pure environment Mawsynram. In this tour package, you will be visiting the famous artificial Umiam Lake and Shillong city's well-known places. Visit Cherrapunji and its amazing waterfalls and caves along with a visit to the cleanest village in Asia, Mawlynnong.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Tour of the stunning man-made Umiam Lake
Visit Shillong's best places like Lady Hydari Park, Ward’s Lake, Shillong Golf Course and many amazing locations
Witness Cherrapunji’s stunning waterfalls, caves and park
Head to Mawlynnong which is Asia’s cleanest village
Enjoy boating on the Umngot River, which is beautifully clear and where the riverbed can be seen from the surface
A day trip to Smit, the seat of Khasi royalty and heritage and a visit to Laitlum Canyons
Visit Mawphlang Sacred Forest, a one-of-a-kind approach to environmental preservation
Move to Mawsynram and visit Mawjymbuin cave and Mawlynbna village
A visit to Jaintia Hills and explore Thadlaskein Lake, Tyrshi Falls, Nartiang Monolith Park and Lalong Park

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati
items: Arrive at Guwahati Airport or Railways Station.
Travel to Shillong and en-route witness the beautiful man-made Umiam Lake.
Also, visit Nehru Park at Barapani.
Later check-in at your hotel in Shillong.

days.title: Day 2 : Shillong City Trip
items: Wake up in the capital city of Meghalaya and have your breakfast.
Start your tour to Shillong and visit the famous Lady Hydari Park and Ward’s Lake.
Also, visit Shillong Golf Course and spend some time enjoying the view of its greenery.
Later, In the evening, take a stroll around Shillong's streets.
Check in to your hotel at Shillong for a restful sleep.

days.title: Day 3 : Shillong to Cherrapunji
items: Have your delightful breakfast and drive to Cherrapunji.
En way, take in the breathtaking scenery of Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Visit the wettest place on earth and witness stunning waterfalls like Nohkalikai Falls and Wei Sawdong Falls.
Also, witness the mysterious Mawsmai Caves and Arwah Caves.
Thereafter head to the famous Eco Park of Cherrapunji and spend quality time with your family or friend.
Check in to your hotel in Cherrapunji and have a peaceful sleep.

days.title: Day 4 : Mawlynnong-Dawki Visit
items: After your delicious breakfast drive to Mawlynnong.
Witness the cleanest village in Asia, Mawlynnong.
Visit the amazing Balancing Rock and the Living Root Bridge.
Later, head to the Indo-Bangladesh Border in Dawki.
Enjoy a boat ride on the Umngot River's crystal blue water, where the riverbed can be seen from the surface.
Then return to Mawlynnong and check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 5 : Smit-Laitlum-Shillong
items: Have your breakfast and start your tour to Smit.
Day excursion of Smit which showcases the Khasi royalty and tradition.
Take in the serene beauty of the villages.
Later, travel to Laitlum to experience the amazing sunset vista of the Laitlum Canyons.
Return to Shillong and check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 6 : Mawphlang and Mawsynram
items: Wake up full of energy and drive to Mawphlang.
Visit Mawphlang village and its Sacred Groves.
Stroll along the village pathways and see a variety of plant types.
After that, travel to Mawsynram to see the Mawjymbuin Caves and Mawlyngbna settlement.
In the evening return to Shillong and check in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 7 : Jaintia Hills Tour
items: After breakfast, travel to Jaintia Hills.
The Jaintia Hills are home to Meghalaya's Jaintia tribes.
The picturesque Thadlaskein Lake and Tyrshi Falls are worth seeing.
Before evening visit Nartiang Monolith Park and Lalong Park and spend some precious time with your friend or family.
Later, return back to Shillong for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day 8 : Shillong to Guwahati(Departure)
items: After breakfast, go on the schedule for the evening flight to Guwahati Airport (120 km/4 hours drive).

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
